name: In-package reading and test crosswalk
sources: Reproducibility and Use Standard 1.7 Section 3 and Section 3.1A
external_registry: CANONICAL_STATE_REGISTRY_v1.1.yaml is not bundled or verified; this file does not assert equivalence or replace it.

ordinary_decision_rules.condition: Complete decisive ALLOW_FRAMEWORK_SELECTION, including an option with valid constitutive controls
Non-decisive tie-break preference without a separate lawful authority selection
ordinary_decision_rules.qualification: Preserve the actual governing refusal or escalation disposition, not an invented successful decision.

ordinary_decision_rules.condition: REFUSE_DETERMINISTIC_SELECTION plus a separate lawful AuthoritySelectionRecord
A separately documented ordinary provisional choice, neither a decisive selection nor an authority-selected non-decisive choice

limits: This is not an exhaustive normative transition graph.
Gate tokens cannot be accepted without their evidence, scope and prerequisites.
The synthetic decision fixture does not implement every emergency, sole-survivor or run-record path.
A decision state is not execution authorization.
Exact external-schema or full-registry conformance remains unverified.
